== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Evader (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. Compared with [[Evader (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 E card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>06dc202ce06c656a0baf98a1ffcbef3b329f1a4a</code>.
